{-# OPTIONS --without-K --safe #-}
module HiDreamImageTransformer2DModel

import Data.Vect
import Data.Fin
import Data.Nat
import Data.Bool
import Data.Maybe

public export
Tensor : Nat -> Nat -> Type
Tensor n m = Vect n (Vect m Double)

public export
sum : Num a => Vect n a -> a
sum [] = 0
sum (x :: xs) = x + sum xs

public export
allFins : (n : Nat) -> Vect n (Fin n)
allFins Z = []
allFins (S k) = FZ :: map FS (allFins k)

public export
transpose : {m, n : Nat} -> Tensor m n -> Tensor n m
transpose [] = replicate _ []
transpose (x :: xs) = zipWith (::) x (transpose xs)

public export
dot : Num a => Vect n a -> Vect n a -> a
dot xs ys = sum (zipWith (*) xs ys)

public export
matMul : {m, n, p : Nat} -> Tensor m n -> Tensor n p -> Tensor m p
matMul a b = map (\row => map (\col => dot row col) (transpose b)) a

public export
scaleTensor : Num a => a -> Tensor n m -> Tensor n m
scaleTensor s = map (map (* s))

public export
addTensor : Num a => Tensor n m -> Tensor n m -> Tensor n m
addTensor = zipWith (zipWith (+))

public export
scaleVect : Num a => a -> Vect n a -> Vect n a
scaleVect s = map (* s)

public export
addVect : Num a => Vect n a -> Vect n a -> Vect n a
addVect = zipWith (+)

public export
mulVect : Num a => Vect n a -> Vect n a -> Vect n a
mulVect = zipWith (*)

public export
divVect : Fractional a => Vect n a -> a -> Vect n a
divVect xs d = map (/ d) xs

public export
maximum : Ord a => Vect (S n) a -> a
maximum (x :: []) = x
maximum (x :: (y :: xs)) = let m = maximum (y :: xs) in if x > y then x else m

public export
softmax : Vect (S n) Double -> Vect (S n) Double
softmax xs = let m = maximum xs
                 ex = map (\x => exp (x - m)) xs
                 s = sum ex
             in map (\x => x / s) ex

public export
silu : Double -> Double
silu x = x / (1.0 + exp (negate x))

public export
splitAt : (n : Nat) -> Vect (n + m) a -> (Vect n a, Vect m a)
splitAt Z xs = ([], xs)
splitAt (S k) (x :: xs) = let (ys, zs) = splitAt k xs in (x :: ys, zs)

public export
take : (n : Nat) -> Vect (n + m) a -> Vect n a
take n xs = fst (splitAt n xs)

public export
drop : (n : Nat) -> Vect (n + m) a -> Vect m a
drop n xs = snd (splitAt n xs)

public export
record Linear (inFeatures : Nat) (outFeatures : Nat) where
  constructor MkLinear
  weight : Tensor outFeatures inFeatures
  bias : Vect outFeatures Double

public export
forwardLinear : {inF, outF, b : Nat} -> Linear inF outF -> Tensor b inF -> Tensor b outF
forwardLinear (MkLinear w bias) x = let prod = matMul x (transpose w)
                                         biasMat = replicate b bias
                                     in zipWith addVect prod biasMat

public export
record LayerNorm (normalizedShape : Nat) where
  constructor MkLayerNorm
  weight : Vect normalizedShape Double
  bias : Vect normalizedShape Double
  eps : Double

public export
castNatDouble : Nat -> Double
castNatDouble Z = 0.0
castNatDouble (S k) = 1.0 + castNatDouble k

public export
forwardLayerNorm : {d, b : Nat} -> LayerNorm d -> Tensor b d -> Tensor b d
forwardLayerNorm ln x = let dNat = castNatDouble d
                            mean = map (\row => sum row / dNat) x
                            diff = zipWith (\row, m => map (\v => v - m) row) x mean
                            variance = map (\row => sum (map (\v => v * v) row) / dNat) diff
                            invStd = map (\v => 1.0 / sqrt (v + ln.eps)) variance
                            norm = zipWith (\row, s => scaleVect s row) diff invStd
                            scaled = map (mulVect ln.weight) norm
                        in zipWith addVect scaled (replicate b ln.bias)

public export
record Attention (dim : Nat) (numHeads : Nat) (headDim : Nat) where
  constructor MkAttention
  qProj : Linear dim dim
  kProj : Linear dim dim
  vProj : Linear dim dim
  outProj : Linear dim dim
  scale : Double

public export
forwardAttention : {dim, nH, hD, b, seq : Nat} -> Attention dim nH hD -> Tensor b seq dim -> Maybe (Tensor b seq 1) -> Maybe (Tensor b seq dim) -> Tensor b seq dim
forwardAttention attn x mask rope = let q = forwardLinear attn.qProj x
                                         k = forwardLinear attn.kProj x
                                         v = forwardLinear attn.vProj x
                                         qRope = case rope of Just r => addTensor q r; Nothing => q
                                         kRope = case rope of Just r => addTensor k r; Nothing => k
                                         scores = matMul qRope (transpose kRope)
                                         scaledScores = scaleTensor attn.scale scores
                                         maskedScores = case mask of Just m => zipWith (\rowS, mv => if head mv > 0.5 then rowS else map (const (negate 1.0 / 0.0)) rowS) scaledScores m; Nothing => scaledScores
                                         attnWeights = map softmax maskedScores
                                         context = matMul attnWeights v
                                         output = forwardLinear attn.outProj context
                                     in output

public export
record FeedForward (dim : Nat) (hiddenDim : Nat) where
  constructor MkFeedForward
  w1 : Linear dim hiddenDim
  w2 : Linear hiddenDim dim
  w3 : Linear dim hiddenDim

public export
forwardFeedForward : {dim, hDim, b, seq : Nat} -> FeedForward dim hDim -> Tensor b seq dim -> Tensor b seq dim
forwardFeedForward ff x = let gate = map (map silu) (forwardLinear ff.w1 x)
                              up = forwardLinear ff.w3 x
                              temp = zipWith mulVect gate up
                              out = forwardLinear ff.w2 temp
                          in out

public export
record MOEFeedForward (dim : Nat) (hiddenDim : Nat) (numExperts : Nat) (numActivated : Nat) where
  constructor MkMOEFeedForward
  gate : Linear dim numExperts
  experts : Vect numExperts (FeedForward dim hiddenDim)

public export
insertBy : (a -> a -> Bool) -> a -> Vect n a -> Vect (S n) a
insertBy p x [] = [x]
insertBy p x (y :: ys) = if p x y then x :: y :: ys else y :: insertBy p x ys

public export
sortPairs : Vect n (Fin n, Double) -> Vect n (Fin n, Double)
sortPairs [] = []
sortPairs (x :: xs) = insertBy (\p1, p2 => snd p1 > snd p2) x (sortPairs xs)

public export
selectTopK : {n : Nat} -> (k : Nat) -> Vect n Double -> Vect k (Fin n)
selectTopK k xs = take k (map fst (sortPairs (zip (allFins n) xs)))

public export
forwardMOE : {dim, hDim, nExp, nAct, b, seq : Nat} -> MOEFeedForward dim hDim nExp nAct -> Tensor b seq dim -> Tensor b seq dim
forwardMOE moe x = let logits = forwardLinear moe.gate x
                       weights = map (\row => let s = sum row in if s == 0.0 then row else map (/ s) row) logits
                       routeToken : Vect nExp Double -> Vect dim Double -> Vect dim Double
                       routeToken wRow tokenRow = let topIndices = selectTopK nAct wRow
                                                      expertOutputs = map (\i => head (forwardFeedForward (index i moe.experts) (replicate 1 tokenRow))) topIndices
                                                      weighted = map (\eo => scaleVect (index (finToNat (fst eo)) wRow) (snd eo)) (zip topIndices expertOutputs)
                                                  in foldl addVect (replicate _ 0.0) weighted
                       processedRows = zipWith routeToken weights x
                   in processedRows

public export
record TextProjection (inFeatures : Nat) (hiddenSize : Nat) where
  constructor MkTextProjection
  linear : Linear inFeatures hiddenSize

public export
forwardTextProjection : {inF, hS, b, seq : Nat} -> TextProjection inF hS -> Tensor b seq inF -> Tensor b seq hS
forwardTextProjection tp x = forwardLinear tp.linear x

public export
record HiDreamImageSingleTransformerBlock (dim : Nat) (numAttentionHeads : Nat) (attentionHeadDim : Nat) (numRoutedExperts : Nat) (numActivatedExperts : Nat) where
  constructor MkHiDreamImageSingleTransformerBlock
  adaLNModulation : Linear dim (mult dim 6)
  norm1 : LayerNorm dim
  attn1 : Attention dim numAttentionHeads attentionHeadDim
  norm3 : LayerNorm dim
  ff : Either (FeedForward dim (mult dim 4)) (MOEFeedForward dim (mult dim 4) numRoutedExperts numActivatedExperts)

public export
forwardHiDreamImageSingleTransformerBlock : {dim, nH, hD, nRE, nAE, b, seq : Nat} -> HiDreamImageSingleTransformerBlock dim nH hD nRE nAE -> Tensor b seq dim -> Maybe (Tensor b seq 1) -> Maybe (Tensor b seq dim) -> Tensor b 1 dim -> Maybe (Tensor b seq dim) -> Tensor b seq dim
forwardHiDreamImageSingleTransformerBlock block imageTokens masks textTokens adalnInput rope = let mods = forwardLinear block.adaLNModulation adalnInput
                                                                                                     modsVec = head mods
                                                                                                     shiftMsa = take dim modsVec
                                                                                                     scaleMsa = take dim (drop dim modsVec)
                                                                                                     gateMsa = take dim (drop (mult dim 2) modsVec)
                                                                                                     shiftMlp = take dim (drop (mult dim 3) modsVec)
                                                                                                     scaleMlp = take dim (drop (mult dim 4) modsVec)
                                                                                                     gateMlp = take dim (drop (mult dim 5) modsVec)
                                                                                                     normImg = forwardLayerNorm block.norm1 imageTokens
                                                                                                     modNormImg = zipWith (\row, s => addVect (mulVect scaleMsa row) shiftMsa) normImg (replicate _ scaleMsa)
                                                                                                     attnOut = forwardAttention block.attn1 modNormImg masks rope
                                                                                                     gatedAttn = zipWith (\row, ao => addVect row (mulVect gateMsa ao)) imageTokens attnOut
                                                                                                     normImg2 = forwardLayerNorm block.norm3 gatedAttn
                                                                                                     modNormImg2 = zipWith (\row, s => addVect (mulVect scaleMlp row) shiftMlp) normImg2 (replicate _ scaleMlp)
                                                                                                     ffOut = case block.ff of Left ff => forwardFeedForward ff modNormImg2; Right moe => forwardMOE moe modNormImg2
                                                                                                     gatedFf = zipWith (\row, ffR => addVect row (mulVect gateMlp ffR)) gatedAttn ffOut
                                                                                                 in gatedFf

public export
record HiDreamImageTransformerBlock (dim : Nat) (numAttentionHeads : Nat) (attentionHeadDim : Nat) (numRoutedExperts : Nat) (numActivatedExperts : Nat) where
  constructor MkHiDreamImageTransformerBlock
  adaLNModulation : Linear dim (mult dim 12)
  norm1I : LayerNorm dim
  norm1T : LayerNorm dim
  attn1 : Attention dim numAttentionHeads attentionHeadDim
  norm3I : LayerNorm dim
  ffI : Either (FeedForward dim (mult dim 4)) (MOEFeedForward dim (mult dim 4) numRoutedExperts numActivatedExperts)
  norm3T : LayerNorm dim
  ffT : FeedForward dim (mult dim 4)

public export
forwardHiDreamImageTransformerBlock : {dim, nH, hD, nRE, nAE, b, seqI, seqT : Nat} -> HiDreamImageTransformerBlock dim nH hD nRE nAE -> Tensor b seqI dim -> Maybe (Tensor b seqI 1) -> Tensor b seqT dim -> Tensor b 1 dim -> Maybe (Tensor b (seqI + seqT) dim) -> (Tensor b seqI dim, Tensor b seqT dim)
forwardHiDreamImageTransformerBlock block imageTokens masks textTokens adalnInput rope = let mods = forwardLinear block.adaLNModulation adalnInput
                                                                                              modsVec = head mods
                                                                                              shiftMsaI = take dim modsVec
                                                                                              scaleMsaI = take dim (drop dim modsVec)
                                                                                              gateMsaI = take dim (drop (mult dim 2) modsVec)
                                                                                              shiftMlpI = take dim (drop (mult dim 3) modsVec)
                                                                                              scaleMlpI = take dim (drop (mult dim 4) modsVec)
                                                                                              gateMlpI = take dim (drop (mult dim 5) modsVec)
                                                                                              shiftMsaT = take dim (drop (mult dim 6) modsVec)
                                                                                              scaleMsaT = take dim (drop (mult dim 7) modsVec)
                                                                                              gateMsaT = take dim (drop (mult dim 8) modsVec)
                                                                                              shiftMlpT = take dim (drop (mult dim 9) modsVec)
                                                                                              scaleMlpT = take dim (drop (mult dim 10) modsVec)
                                                                                              gateMlpT = take dim (drop (mult dim 11) modsVec)
                                                                                              normI = forwardLayerNorm block.norm1I imageTokens
                                                                                              modNormI = zipWith (\row, s => addVect (mulVect scaleMsaI row) shiftMsaI) normI (replicate _ scaleMsaI)
                                                                                              normT = forwardLayerNorm block.norm1T textTokens
                                                                                              modNormT = zipWith (\row, s => addVect (mulVect scaleMsaT row) shiftMsaT) normT (replicate _ scaleMsaT)
                                                                                              ropeI = case rope of Just r => Just (map (take seqI) r); Nothing => Nothing
                                                                                              ropeT = case rope of Just r => Just (map (drop seqI) r); Nothing => Nothing
                                                                                              attnOutI = forwardAttention block.attn1 modNormI masks ropeI
                                                                                              attnOutT = forwardAttention block.attn1 modNormT Nothing ropeT
                                                                                              gatedI = zipWith (\row, aR => addVect row (mulVect gateMsaI aR)) imageTokens attnOutI
                                                                                              gatedT = zipWith (\row, aR => addVect row (mulVect gateMsaT aR)) textTokens attnOutT
                                                                                              normI2 = forwardLayerNorm block.norm3I gatedI
                                                                                              modNormI2 = zipWith (\row, s => addVect (mulVect scaleMlpI row) shiftMlpI) normI2 (replicate _ scaleMlpI)
                                                                                              ffOutI = case block.ffI of Left ff => forwardFeedForward ff modNormI2; Right moe => forwardMOE moe modNormI2
                                                                                              resI = zipWith (\row, ffR => addVect row (mulVect gateMlpI ffR)) gatedI ffOutI
                                                                                              normT2 = forwardLayerNorm block.norm3T gatedT
                                                                                              modNormT2 = zipWith (\row, s => addVect (mulVect scaleMlpT row) shiftMlpT) normT2 (replicate _ scaleMlpT)
                                                                                              ffOutT = forwardFeedForward block.ffT modNormT2
                                                                                              resT = zipWith (\row, ffR => addVect row (mulVect gateMlpT ffR)) gatedT ffOutT
                                                                                          in (resI, resT)

public export
record HiDreamImageBlock (dim : Nat) (numAttentionHeads : Nat) (attentionHeadDim : Nat) (numRoutedExperts : Nat) (numActivatedExperts : Nat) where
  constructor MkHiDreamImageBlock
  isSingle : Bool
  singleBlock : Maybe (HiDreamImageSingleTransformerBlock dim numAttentionHeads attentionHeadDim numRoutedExperts numActivatedExperts)
  doubleBlock : Maybe (HiDreamImageTransformerBlock dim numAttentionHeads attentionHeadDim numRoutedExperts numActivatedExperts)

public export
forwardHiDreamImageBlock : {dim, nH, hD, nRE, nAE, b, seqI, seqT : Nat} -> HiDreamImageBlock dim nH hD nRE nAE -> Tensor b seqI dim -> Maybe (Tensor b seqI 1) -> Tensor b seqT dim -> Tensor b 1 dim -> Maybe (Tensor b (seqI + seqT) dim) -> (Tensor b seqI dim, Tensor b seqT dim)
forwardHiDreamImageBlock block img mask txt ada rope = if block.isSingle then case block.singleBlock of Just sb => let outI = forwardHiDreamImageSingleTransformerBlock sb img mask txt ada (case rope of Just r => Just (map (take seqI) r); Nothing => Nothing) in (outI, txt); Nothing => (img, txt) else case block.doubleBlock of Just db => forwardHiDreamImageTransformerBlock db img mask txt ada rope; Nothing => (img, txt)

public export
record Config where
  constructor MkConfig
  patchSize : Nat
  inChannels : Nat
  outChannels : Nat
  numLayers : Nat
  numSingleLayers : Nat
  attentionHeadDim : Nat
  numAttentionHeads : Nat
  captionChannels : List Nat
  textEmbDim : Nat
  numRoutedExperts : Nat
  numActivatedExperts : Nat
  axesDimsRope : (Nat, Nat)
  maxResolution : (Nat, Nat)
  llamaLayers : List Nat

public export
record HiDreamImageTransformer2DModel (cfg : Config) where
  constructor MkHiDreamImageTransformer2DModel
  tEmbedder : Linear 1 (mult cfg.numAttentionHeads cfg.attentionHeadDim)
  pEmbedder : Linear cfg.textEmbDim (mult cfg.numAttentionHeads cfg.attentionHeadDim)
  xEmbedder : Linear (mult (mult cfg.patchSize cfg.patchSize) cfg.inChannels) (mult cfg.numAttentionHeads cfg.attentionHeadDim)
  peEmbedder : Linear 3 (mult cfg.attentionHeadDim cfg.numAttentionHeads)
  doubleStreamBlocks : Vect cfg.numLayers (HiDreamImageBlock (mult cfg.numAttentionHeads cfg.attentionHeadDim) cfg.numAttentionHeads cfg.attentionHeadDim cfg.numRoutedExperts cfg.numActivatedExperts)
  singleStreamBlocks : Vect cfg.numSingleLayers (HiDreamImageBlock (mult cfg.numAttentionHeads cfg.attentionHeadDim) cfg.numAttentionHeads cfg.attentionHeadDim cfg.numRoutedExperts cfg.numActivatedExperts)
  finalLayer : Linear (mult cfg.numAttentionHeads cfg.attentionHeadDim) (mult (mult cfg.patchSize cfg.patchSize) cfg.outChannels)
  captionProjection : Vect (S (plus cfg.numLayers cfg.numSingleLayers)) (TextProjection 2048 (mult cfg.numAttentionHeads cfg.attentionHeadDim))

public export
forwardHiDreamImageTransformer2DModel : {cfg : Config} -> HiDreamImageTransformer2DModel cfg -> Tensor 1 128 Double -> Maybe (Tensor 1 1 Double) -> Vect 2 (Tensor 1 2048 Double) -> Tensor 1 2048 Double -> Maybe (Vect 1 (Nat, Nat)) -> Tensor 1 3 3 -> Bool -> (Tensor 1 (mult (mult cfg.patchSize cfg.patchSize) cfg.outChannels) Double, Maybe (Tensor 1 1 Double))
forwardHiDreamImageTransformer2DModel model hiddenStates timesteps encoderHiddenStates pooledEmbeds imgSizes imgIds isTraining = let dim = mult cfg.numAttentionHeads cfg.attentionHeadDim
                                                                                                                                       tEmb = forwardLinear model.tEmbedder (replicate 1 [1.0])
                                                                                                                                       pEmb = forwardLinear model.pEmbedder pooledEmbeds
                                                                                                                                       adaln = addTensor tEmb pEmb
                                                                                                                                       xEmb = forwardLinear model.xEmbedder hiddenStates
                                                                                                                                       ropeEmb = forwardLinear model.peEmbedder imgIds
                                                                                                                                       txtProj = map (\tp => forwardTextProjection tp (head encoderHiddenStates)) model.captionProjection
                                                                                                                                       txtState = head txtProj
                                                                                                                                       imgState = xEmb
                                                                                                                                       processDouble : Tensor 1 (S n) dim -> Tensor 1 (S m) dim -> Vect l (HiDreamImageBlock dim cfg.numAttentionHeads cfg.attentionHeadDim cfg.numRoutedExperts cfg.numActivatedExperts) -> (Tensor 1 (S n) dim, Tensor 1 (S m) dim)
                                                                                                                                       processDouble i t [] = (i, t)
                                                                                                                                       processDouble i t (block :: rest) = let (ni, nt) = forwardHiDreamImageBlock block i Nothing t adaln Nothing in processDouble ni nt rest
                                                                                                                                       (afterDouble, txtAfterDouble) = processDouble imgState txtState model.doubleStreamBlocks
                                                                                                                                       combined = afterDouble ++ txtAfterDouble
                                                                                                                                       processSingle : Tensor 1 (S n) dim -> Vect l (HiDreamImageBlock dim cfg.numAttentionHeads cfg.attentionHeadDim cfg.numRoutedExperts cfg.numActivatedExperts) -> Tensor 1 (S n) dim
                                                                                                                                       processSingle s [] = s
                                                                                                                                       processSingle s (block :: rest) = let ns = fst (forwardHiDreamImageBlock block s Nothing (replicate 1 (replicate _ 0.0)) adaln Nothing) in processSingle ns rest
                                                                                                                                       finalHidden = processSingle combined model.singleStreamBlocks
                                                                                                                                       outputFlat = forwardLinear model.finalLayer finalHidden
                                                                                                                                       pooled = map (\row => divVect row (castNatDouble (length row))) outputFlat
                                                                                                                                   in (pooled, Nothing)

                            mean = map (\row => sum row / dNat) x
                            diff = zipWith (\row, m => map (\v => v - m) row) x mean
                            variance = map (\row => sum (map (\v => v * v) row) / dNat) diff
                            invStd = map (\v => 1.0 / sqrt (v + ln.eps)) variance
                            norm = zipWith (\row, s => scaleVect s row) diff invStd
                            scaled = map (mulVect ln.weight) norm
                        in zipWith addVect scaled (replicate b ln.bias)

public export
record Attention (dim : Nat) (numHeads : Nat) (headDim : Nat) where
  constructor MkAttention
  qProj : Linear dim dim
  kProj : Linear dim dim
  vProj : Linear dim dim
  outProj : Linear dim dim
  scale : Double

public export
forwardAttention : {dim, nH, hD, b, seq : Nat} -> Attention dim nH hD -> Tensor b seq dim -> Maybe (Tensor b seq 1) -> Maybe (Tensor b seq dim) -> Tensor b seq dim
forwardAttention attn x mask rope = let q = forwardLinear attn.qProj x
                                         k = forwardLinear attn.kProj x
                                         v = forwardLinear attn.vProj x
                                         qRope = case rope of Just r => addTensor q r; Nothing => q
                                         kRope = case rope of Just r => addTensor k r; Nothing => k
                                         scores = matMul qRope (transpose kRope)
                                         scaledScores = scaleTensor attn.scale scores
                                         maskedScores = case mask of Just m => zipWith (\rowS, mv => if head mv > 0.5 then rowS else map (const (negate 1.0 / 0.0)) rowS) scaledScores m; Nothing => scaledScores
                                         attnWeights = map softmax maskedScores
                                         context = matMul attnWeights v
                                         output = forwardLinear attn.outProj context
                                     in output

public export
record FeedForward (dim : Nat) (hiddenDim : Nat) where
  constructor MkFeedForward
  w1 : Linear dim hiddenDim
  w2 : Linear hiddenDim dim
  w3 : Linear dim hiddenDim

public export
forwardFeedForward : {dim, hDim, b, seq : Nat} -> FeedForward dim hDim -> Tensor b seq dim -> Tensor b seq dim
forwardFeedForward ff x = let gate = map (map silu) (forwardLinear ff.w1 x)
                              up = forwardLinear ff.w3 x
                              temp = zipWith mulVect gate up
                              out = forwardLinear ff.w2 temp
                          in out

public export
record MOEFeedForward (dim : Nat) (hiddenDim : Nat) (numExperts : Nat) (numActivated : Nat) where
  constructor MkMOEFeedForward
  gate : Linear dim numExperts
  experts : Vect numExperts (FeedForward dim hiddenDim)

public export
insertBy : (a -> a -> Bool) -> a -> Vect n a -> Vect (S n) a
insertBy p x [] = [x]
insertBy p x (y :: ys) = if p x y then x :: y :: ys else y :: insertBy p x ys

public export
sortPairs : Vect n (Fin n, Double) -> Vect n (Fin n, Double)
sortPairs [] = []
sortPairs (x :: xs) = insertBy (\p1, p2 => snd p1 > snd p2) x (sortPairs xs)

public export
selectTopK : {n : Nat} -> (k : Nat) -> Vect n Double -> Vect k (Fin n)
selectTopK k xs = take k (map fst (sortPairs (zip (allFins n) xs)))

public export
forwardMOE : {dim, hDim, nExp, nAct, b, seq : Nat} -> MOEFeedForward dim hDim nExp nAct -> Tensor b seq dim -> Tensor b seq dim
forwardMOE moe x = let logits = forwardLinear moe.gate x
                       weights = map (\row => let s = sum row in if s == 0.0 then row else map (/ s) row) logits
                       routeToken : Vect nExp Double -> Vect dim Double -> Vect dim Double
                       routeToken wRow tokenRow = let topIndices = selectTopK nAct wRow
                                                      expertOutputs = map (\i => head (forwardFeedForward (index i moe.experts) (replicate 1 tokenRow))) topIndices
                                                      weighted = map (\eo => scaleVect (index (finToNat (fst eo)) wRow) (snd eo)) (zip topIndices expertOutputs)
                                                  in foldl addVect (replicate _ 0.0) weighted
                       processedRows = zipWith routeToken weights x
                   in processedRows

public export
record TextProjection (inFeatures : Nat) (hiddenSize : Nat) where
  constructor MkTextProjection
  linear : Linear inFeatures hiddenSize

public export
forwardTextProjection : {inF, hS, b, seq : Nat} -> TextProjection inF hS -> Tensor b seq inF -> Tensor b seq hS
forwardTextProjection tp x = forwardLinear tp.linear x

record HiDreamImageSingleTransformerBlock (dim : Nat) (numAttentionHeads : Nat) (attentionHeadDim : Nat) (numRoutedExperts : Nat) (numActivatedExperts : Nat) where
  constructor MkHiDreamImageSingleTransformerBlock
  adaLNModulation : Linear dim (mult dim 6)
  norm1 : LayerNorm dim
  attn1 : Attention dim numAttentionHeads attentionHeadDim
  norm3 : LayerNorm dim
  ff : Either (FeedForward dim (mult dim 4)) (MOEFeedForward dim (mult dim 4) numRoutedExperts numActivatedExperts)

public export
forwardHiDreamImageSingleTransformerBlock : {dim, nH, hD, nRE, nAE, b, seq : Nat} -> HiDreamImageSingleTransformerBlock dim nH hD nRE nAE -> Tensor b seq dim -> Maybe (Tensor b seq 1) -> Maybe (Tensor b seq dim) -> Tensor b 1 dim -> Maybe (Tensor b seq dim) -> Tensor b seq dim
forwardHiDreamImageSingleTransformerBlock block imageTokens masks textTokens adalnInput rope = let mods = forwardLinear block.adaLNModulation adalnInput
                                                                                                     modsVec = head mods
                                                                                                     shiftMsa = take dim modsVec
                                                                                                     scaleMsa = take dim (drop dim modsVec)
                                                                                                     gateMsa = take dim (drop (mult dim 2) modsVec)
                                                                                                     shiftMlp = take dim (drop (mult dim 3) modsVec)
                                                                                                     scaleMlp = take dim (drop (mult dim 4) modsVec)
                                                                                                     gateMlp = take dim (drop (mult dim 5) modsVec)
                                                                                                     normImg = forwardLayerNorm block.norm1 imageTokens
                                                                                                     modNormImg = zipWith (\row, s => addVect (mulVect scaleMsa row) shiftMsa) normImg (replicate _ scaleMsa)
                                                                                                     attnOut = forwardAttention block.attn1 modNormImg masks rope
                                                                                                     gatedAttn = zipWith (\row, ao => addVect row (mulVect gateMsa ao)) imageTokens attnOut
                                                                                                     normImg2 = forwardLayerNorm block.norm3 gatedAttn
                                                                                                     modNormImg2 = zipWith (\row, s => addVect (mulVect scaleMlp row) shiftMlp) normImg2 (replicate _ scaleMlp)
                                                                                                     ffOut = case block.ff of Left ff => forwardFeedForward ff modNormImg2; Right moe => forwardMOE moe modNormImg2
                                                                                                     gatedFf = zipWith (\row, ffR => addVect row (mulVect gateMlp ffR)) gatedAttn ffOut
                                                                                                 in gatedFf

public export
record HiDreamImageTransformerBlock (dim : Nat) (numAttentionHeads : Nat) (attentionHeadDim : Nat) (numRoutedExperts : Nat) (numActivatedExperts : Nat) where
  constructor MkHiDreamImageTransformerBlock
  adaLNModulation : Linear dim (mult dim 12)
  norm1I : LayerNorm dim
  norm1T : LayerNorm dim
  attn1 : Attention dim numAttentionHeads attentionHeadDim
  norm3I : LayerNorm dim
  ffI : Either (FeedForward dim (mult dim 4)) (MOEFeedForward dim (mult dim 4) numRoutedExperts numActivatedExperts)
  norm3T : LayerNorm dim
  ffT : FeedForward dim (mult dim 4)

public export
forwardHiDreamImageTransformerBlock : {dim, nH, hD, nRE, nAE, b, seqI, seqT : Nat} -> HiDreamImageTransformerBlock dim nH hD nRE nAE -> Tensor b seqI dim -> Maybe (Tensor b seqI 1) -> Tensor b seqT dim -> Tensor b 1 dim -> Maybe (Tensor b (seqI + seqT) dim) -> (Tensor b seqI dim, Tensor b seqT dim)
forwardHiDreamImageTransformerBlock block imageTokens masks textTokens adalnInput rope = let mods = forwardLinear block.adaLNModulation adalnInput
                                                                                              modsVec = head mods
                                                                                              shiftMsaI = take dim modsVec
                                                                                              scaleMsaI = take dim (drop dim modsVec)
                                                                                              gateMsaI = take dim (drop (mult dim 2) modsVec)
                                                                                              shiftMlpI = take dim (drop (mult dim 3) modsVec)
                                                                                              scaleMlpI = take dim (drop (mult dim 4) modsVec)
                                                                                              gateMlpI = take dim (drop (mult dim 5) modsVec)
                                                                                              shiftMsaT = take dim (drop (mult dim 6) modsVec)
                                                                                              scaleMsaT = take dim (drop (mult dim 7) modsVec)
                                                                                              gateMsaT = take dim (drop (mult dim 8) modsVec)
                                                                                              shiftMlpT = take dim (drop (mult dim 9) modsVec)
                                                                                              scaleMlpT = take dim (drop (mult dim 10) modsVec)
                                                                                              gateMlpT = take dim (drop (mult dim 11) modsVec)
                                                                                              normI = forwardLayerNorm block.norm1I imageTokens
                                                                                              modNormI = zipWith (\row, s => addVect (mulVect scaleMsaI row) shiftMsaI) normI (replicate _ scaleMsaI)
                                                                                              normT = forwardLayerNorm block.norm1T textTokens
                                                                                              modNormT = zipWith (\row, s => addVect (mulVect scaleMsaT row) shiftMsaT) normT (replicate _ scaleMsaT)
                                                                                              ropeI = case rope of Just r => Just (map (take seqI) r); Nothing => Nothing
                                                                                              ropeT = case rope of Just r => Just (map (drop seqI) r); Nothing => Nothing
                                                                                              attnOutI = forwardAttention block.attn1 modNormI masks ropeI
                                                                                              attnOutT = forwardAttention block.attn1 modNormT Nothing ropeT
                                                                                              gatedI = zipWith (\row, aR => addVect row (mulVect gateMsaI aR)) imageTokens attnOutI
                                                                                              gatedT = zipWith (\row, aR => addVect row (mulVect gateMsaT aR)) textTokens attnOutT
                                                                                              normI2 = forwardLayerNorm block.norm3I gatedI
                                                                                              modNormI2 = zipWith (\row, s => addVect (mulVect scaleMlpI row) shiftMlpI) normI2 (replicate _ scaleMlpI)
                                                                                              ffOutI = case block.ffI of Left ff => forwardFeedForward ff modNormI2; Right moe => forwardMOE moe modNormI2
                                                                                              resI = zipWith (\row, ffR => addVect row (mulVect gateMlpI ffR)) gatedI ffOutI
                                                                                              normT2 = forwardLayerNorm block.norm3T gatedT
                                                                                              modNormT2 = zipWith (\row, s => addVect (mulVect scaleMlpT row) shiftMlpT) normT2 (replicate _ scaleMlpT)
                                                                                              ffOutT = forwardFeedForward block.ffT modNormT2
                                                                                              resT = zipWith (\row, ffR => addVect row (mulVect gateMlpT ffR)) gatedT ffOutT
                                                                                          in (resI, resT)

public export
record HiDreamImageBlock (dim : Nat) (numAttentionHeads : Nat) (attentionHeadDim : Nat) (numRoutedExperts : Nat) (numActivatedExperts : Nat) where
  constructor MkHiDreamImageBlock
  isSingle : Bool
  singleBlock : Maybe (HiDreamImageSingleTransformerBlock dim numAttentionHeads attentionHeadDim numRoutedExperts numActivatedExperts)
  doubleBlock : Maybe (HiDreamImageTransformerBlock dim numAttentionHeads attentionHeadDim numRoutedExperts numActivatedExperts)

public export
forwardHiDreamImageBlock : {dim, nH, hD, nRE, nAE, b, seqI, seqT : Nat} -> HiDreamImageBlock dim nH hD nRE nAE -> Tensor b seqI dim -> Maybe (Tensor b seqI 1) -> Tensor b seqT dim -> Tensor b 1 dim -> Maybe (Tensor b (seqI + seqT) dim) -> (Tensor b seqI dim, Tensor b seqT dim)
forwardHiDreamImageBlock block img mask txt ada rope = if block.isSingle then case block.singleBlock of Just sb => let outI = forwardHiDreamImageSingleTransformerBlock sb img mask txt ada (case rope of Just r => Just (map (take seqI) r); Nothing => Nothing) in (outI, txt); Nothing => (img, txt) else case block.doubleBlock of Just db => forwardHiDreamImageTransformerBlock db img mask txt ada rope; Nothing => (img, txt)

record Config where
  constructor MkConfig
  patchSize : Nat
  inChannels : Nat
  outChannels : Nat
  numLayers : Nat
  numSingleLayers : Nat
  attentionHeadDim : Nat
  numAttentionHeads : Nat
  captionChannels : List Nat

public export
record HiDreamImageTransformer2DModel (cfg : Config) where
  constructor MkHiDreamImageTransformer2DModel
  tEmbedder : Linear 1 (mult cfg.numAttentionHeads cfg.attentionHeadDim)
  pEmbedder : Linear cfg.textEmbDim (mult cfg.numAttentionHeads cfg.attentionHeadDim)
  xEmbedder : Linear (mult (mult cfg.patchSize cfg.patchSize) cfg.inChannels) (mult cfg.numAttentionHeads cfg.attentionHeadDim)
  peEmbedder : Linear 3 (mult cfg.attentionHeadDim cfg.numAttentionHeads)
  doubleStreamBlocks : Vect cfg.numLayers (HiDreamImageBlock (mult cfg.numAttentionHeads cfg.attentionHeadDim) cfg.numAttentionHeads cfg.attentionHeadDim cfg.numRoutedExperts cfg.numActivatedExperts)
  singleStreamBlocks : Vect cfg.numSingleLayers (HiDreamImageBlock (mult cfg.numAttentionHeads cfg.attentionHeadDim) cfg.numAttentionHeads cfg.attentionHeadDim cfg.numRoutedExperts cfg.numActivatedExperts)
  finalLayer : Linear (mult cfg.numAttentionHeads cfg.attentionHeadDim) (mult (mult cfg.patchSize cfg.patchSize) cfg.outChannels)
  captionProjection : Vect (S (plus cfg.numLayers cfg.numSingleLayers)) (TextProjection 2048 (mult cfg.numAttentionHeads cfg.attentionHeadDim))

public export
forwardHiDreamImageTransformer2DModel : {cfg : Config} -> HiDreamImageTransformer2DModel cfg -> Tensor 1 128 Double -> Maybe (Tensor 1 1 Double) -> Vect 2 (Tensor 1 2048 Double) -> Tensor 1 2048 Double -> Maybe (Vect 1 (Nat, Nat)) -> Tensor 1 3 3 -> Bool -> (Tensor 1 (mult (mult cfg.patchSize cfg.patchSize) cfg.outChannels) Double, Maybe (Tensor 1 1 Double))
forwardHiDreamImageTransformer2DModel model hiddenStates timesteps encoderHiddenStates pooledEmbeds imgSizes imgIds isTraining = let dim = mult cfg.numAttentionHeads cfg.attentionHeadDim
                                                                                                                                       tEmb = forwardLinear model.tEmbedder (replicate 1 [1.0])
                                                                                                                                       pEmb = forwardLinear model.pEmbedder pooledEmbeds
                                                                                                                                       adaln = addTensor tEmb pEmb
                                                                                                                                       xEmb = forwardLinear model.xEmbedder hiddenStates
                                                                                                                                       ropeEmb = forwardLinear model.peEmbedder imgIds
                                                                                                                                       txtProj = map (\tp => forwardTextProjection tp (head encoderHiddenStates)) model.captionProjection
                                                                                                                                       txtState = head txtProj
                                                                                                                                       imgState = xEmb
                                                                                                                                       processDouble : Tensor 1 (S n) dim -> Tensor 1 (S m) dim -> Vect l (HiDreamImageBlock dim cfg.numAttentionHeads cfg.attentionHeadDim cfg.numRoutedExperts cfg.numActivatedExperts) -> (Tensor 1 (S n) dim, Tensor 1 (S m) dim)
                                                                                                                                       processDouble i t [] = (i, t)
                                                                                                                                       processDouble i t (block :: rest) = let (ni, nt) = forwardHiDreamImageBlock block i Nothing t adaln Nothing in processDouble ni nt rest
                                                                                                                                       (afterDouble, txtAfterDouble) = processDouble imgState txtState model.doubleStreamBlocks
                                                                                                                                       combined = afterDouble ++ txtAfterDouble
                                                                                                                                       processSingle : Tensor 1 (S n) dim -> Vect l (HiDreamImageBlock dim cfg.numAttentionHeads cfg.attentionHeadDim cfg.numRoutedExperts cfg.numActivatedExperts) -> Tensor 1 (S n) dim
                                                                                                                                       processSingle s [] = s
                                                                                                                                       processSingle s (block :: rest) = let ns = fst (forwardHiDreamImageBlock block s Nothing (replicate 1 (replicate _ 0.0)) adaln Nothing) in processSingle ns rest
                                                                                                                                       finalHidden = processSingle combined model.singleStreamBlocks
                                                                                                                                       outputFlat = forwardLinear model.finalLayer finalHidden
                                                                                                                                       pooled = map (\row => divVect row (castNatDouble (length row))) outputFlat
                                                                                                                                   in (pooled, Nothing)

## Miért nem valós formális verifikáció?

### Triviális "bizonyítások"
A kód végén szereplő lemmák mind `Refl` (reflexivitás) konstruktorral "bizonyítanak":[1][2]

```idris
matMulRowsLemma : (m, n, p : Nat) -> (a : Tensor m n) -> (b : Tensor n p) -> length (matMul a b) = m
matMulRowsLemma m n p a b = Refl
```

A `Refl` csak akkor működik Idrisben, ha a típusellenőrző automatikusan be tudja látni, hogy két kifejezés ugyanarra a normálformára redukálódik. Ez egyszerű esetekben működik (pl. `map` megőrzi a `Vect` hosszát), de a kódban lévő komplex műveleteknél **nem elegendő**.[3][2]

### Komplex implementációk bizonyítás nélkül

A `forwardHiDreamImageTransformer2DModel` és hasonló függvények:
- Több száz sornyi implementációt tartalmaznak
- Elágazásokkal, rekurzióval, feltételes logikával
- Pattern matchinggel és komplex tensor műveletekkel

Ezekhez **nem triviális indukciós bizonyítások** kellenének, nem egyszerű `Refl`.[4]

### Típushibák a kódban

A kód több helyen is típushibákat tartalmaz:
1. A `maximum` függvény nem kezeli helyesen az `Ord` megszorítást
2. A `softmax` implementáció típushibás (`m` és `y` összehasonlítása)
3. A `splitAt` függvény típusszignatúrája helyes, de a használata sok helyen ellenőrizetlen

### Hiányzik a totality checking

Bár van `total` annotáció a lemmákon, az implementációs függvényeken **nincs**. Valós formális verifikációnál a főbb függvényeknek is `total`-nak kellene lenniük, garantálva a terminálást minden jóltipizált inputon.[4]

### A HiDream modell kontextusa

A HiDream-I1 egy valós neurális hálózat modell 17 milliárd paraméterrel, de ez a kód:[5][6]
- Nem tartalmazza a tényleges súlyok betöltését
- Nem implementálja a valós tensor műveleteket (GPU, XLA stb.)

## Következtetés

Ez egy **didaktikai/demonstrációs célú placeholder kód**, amely megmutatja, hogyan *nézne ki* egy típus-biztos transformer implementáció Idris dependens típusaival, de **nem tartalmaz valós formális bizonyításokat**. A lemmák mind üres állítások `Refl`-fel, amelyek valószínűleg **nem fordulnának le** valós Idris fordítóval a komplex eseteknél.
